name: Santorini

The NetWaiter GetMenu payload returns 26 priced items across Plates&Combos/Veggie/Seafood/Lunch Specials/Kids Meals/Drinks&Desserts/Family Packs with no markup pattern, BUT every item in Starters, Sides&Extras, Salads and Pita Sandwiches (Gyros Pita, Chicken Pita, My Big Fat Greek Burger) plus several core Plates (Gyros Plate, Souvlaki Plate, Half Chicken Plate, Zorba's Platter, Santorini Platter) comes back with PriceText null, MinPrice 0, HasPortions false, Portions null, CanOrderItem false — 42 of 68 total items, including the most iconic core dishes. This is a core-section gap, not an adjunct, so the 26 priced items are not a complete menu. Also tried santorini-island-grill.res-menu.com/menu (found via search) as an alternate full source — it returns HTTP 200 but a genuinely empty body behind Cloudflare, likely JS-rendered. A Chrome-equipped pass on either the NetWaiter site (to see whether the null-priced items resolve after picking an order type) or res-menu.com would likely complete this.

name: Mr. Shwarma
blocked: markup: no website on record, but found the chain's site (mrshawarmausa.com) linking to this location's own ordering storefront, mrshawarmapb.smartonlineorder.com (a WordPress + Clover integration; address on the location page confirms 1050 Garnet Ave). Two independently-reachable priced sources both fail the markup test against each other's implied base: the DoorDash marketplace listing (address-matched, 1050 Garnet Avenue) has ~90 items where dividing by 1.30 lands on round or half-dollar values with essentially no exceptions (e.g. Chicken Shawarma $15.60 -> $12.00, Beef&Lamb $16.90 -> $13.00, Baklava $3.90 -> $3.00) — a clean 30% delivery markup. The restaurant's OWN SmartOnlineOrder/Clover storefront (wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories + /items, prices in integer cents) is lower but still not the wall price: dividing by 1.04 lands on round dollars across nearly every item (Chicken Shawarma $12.48 -> $12.00, Chipotle Chicken $13.52 -> $13.00, Mr. Shawarma Rice $18.72 -> $18.00, Lamb Mandi $27.04 -> $26.00, Pita Bread $1.04 -> $1.00, all $6.24 sides -> $6.00) — the same 4% online-ordering surcharge pattern the playbook already documents for other Clover-family storefronts. Per the never-construct-a-price rule this could not be filed at the divided-out $X.00 figure even though it is recoverable arithmetically. All 19 Catering tray items on the Clover storefront also carry price 0 (modifier/quote-priced, dropped). No unmarked-up source (own menu board photo, PDF) was found without a browser.
